description: Origin airport code for the route
transformation_or_derivation: Used as part of the route-level grouping key
notes_or_concerns: Forms the route key together with dest; only the three New York City airports (EWR, JFK, LGA)

description: Destination airport code for the route
transformation_or_derivation: Used as part of the route-level grouping key
notes_or_concerns: Includes one unusual route, EWR to LGA, with a single cancelled flight

description: Number of flights observed for the route
transformation_or_derivation: Count of flight records grouped by origin and destination
notes_or_concerns: Includes cancelled flights; ranges from 1 to 11,262; 10 routes have fewer than 10 flights, so their averages are unstable

description: Average departure delay for flights on the route in minutes
transformation_or_derivation: Mean of dep_delay grouped by origin and destination
notes_or_concerns: Missing for 1 route (EWR to LGA) where the single scheduled flight was cancelled; known only after flights depart so it causes data leakage if used as a predictor before the season starts

description: Average arrival delay for flights on the route, in minutes (target)
transformation_or_derivation: Mean of arr_delay grouped by origin and destination
notes_or_concerns: Averages only flights with a recorded arrival delay; missing for EWR to LGA (its only flight was cancelled); negative means early on average

description: Maximum arrival delay observed for flights on the route in minutes
transformation_or_derivation: Maximum of arr_delay grouped by origin and destination
notes_or_concerns: Missing for 1 route (EWR to LGA) where the single scheduled flight was cancelled; negative values (down to -22 min) occur on 4 single-flight routes where flights arrived early; known only after flights arrive so cannot be used as a predictor

description: Average flight distance for the route in miles
transformation_or_derivation: Mean of distance grouped by origin and destination
notes_or_concerns: No missing values; ranges from 17 miles (EWR to LGA) to 4,983 miles (JFK to HNL)

description: Average airborne flight time for the route in minutes
transformation_or_derivation: Mean of air_time grouped by origin and destination
notes_or_concerns: Missing for 1 route (EWR to LGA) where the single scheduled flight was cancelled; averages only completed flights

description: Full name of the destination airport
transformation_or_derivation: Joined from airports using dest = faa
notes_or_concerns: Missing for 7 routes whose destination (BQN, PSE, SJU, STT) is not in the airports table

description: Latitude coordinate of the destination airport in decimal degrees
transformation_or_derivation: Joined from airports using dest = faa
notes_or_concerns: Missing for 7 routes whose destination codes (BQN, PSE, SJU, STT) do not appear in the airports table

description: Longitude coordinate of the destination airport in decimal degrees
transformation_or_derivation: Joined from airports using dest = faa
notes_or_concerns: Missing for 7 routes whose destination codes (BQN, PSE, SJU, STT) do not appear in the airports table
